meetings.headline: Water commissioners again declined to move on a Howard Street water extension, asking O'Brien's attorney for a written opinion first.
meetings.summary: The board heard a resident whose self-made service line repair was done without inspection, and agreed to a no-charge leak test and to draft a repair-inspection regulation.
